It is alleged that a vehicle which was carrying white substance was intercepted.
It was revealed that the said substance is supplied by the Applicant to Shree Swami Samartha Milk Sameer Subhahs Mehata vs The State Of Maharashtra on 2 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189653730/

4. The records reveal that the Applicant is a manufacturer of Melamine, a food addition substance.
At this stage, there is no prima facie material to indicate that the Applicant had entered into criminal conspiracy and/or that the Applicant had supplied Melamine to the proprietor of Shree Swami Samarth Milk Collection for the purpose of adulteration of milk.
In such circumstances, in my considered view, this is a fit case for interim bail.
opennyai_summary.2_May_2023__decision:
Hence, the following order :-
(a) In the event of arrest of the Applicant in C.R.No.17/2023 registered with Pandharpur Police Station, Solapur Rural, he shall be released on interim bail till the next date of hearing, on furnishing bail bonds in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount ;

(b) The Applicant shall report to the Investigating Officer for two days i.e. on 05th and 06th May, 2023 between 11:00 a.m. to 02:00 p.m.
(d) The Applicant shall keep the Investigating Officer informed of his current address and mobile contact numbers, and/or change of residence or mobile details, if any,
from time to time.
